verdict.rationale: TaxJar's own documentation shows an "Archive of historical sales tax data" and transactions pushed into TaxJar with a per-line-item product_tax_code, so some per-transaction tax records are retained. Nothing in the evidence shows that each calculation's rate, rules, or address resolution is retained, or that any of it can be exported for audit. missing for 10: retained per-calculation rate and rule breakdown, stored address-resolution/jurisdiction trace, documented audit export of calculation details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, every calculation is reconstructable — the rate, rules, address resolution, and product category that produced each transaction's tax, retained and exportable for an audit

citations.quote: Archive of historical sales tax data
make common requests using our sales tax API such as sales tax calculations and pushing transactions into TaxJar
the TaxJar API allows you to submit a `product_tax_code` parameter with each `line_item` in an order.
